---
name: check-dashboard
description: 'Open the Hong Kong Live dashboard and report what each card shows'
---
Open http://localhost:5500 in the browser.

For each of the three cards - weather, transport, air quality - report:
* the value it is currently showing;
* whether that value looks plausible, or whether it is blank, "undefined", "NaN" or an error message;
* the timestamp shown, if there is one.

Then take a screenshot of the whole page.

Do not change any code. This is a check, not a fix.
